assessment.reason: Concurrent SwiftShader browser sessions and a long-running progression test used the same host during remeasurement. Parent requested no additional concurrent profiling. FPS is not an Android/mobile performance target or isolated before/after result.
assessment.baselineCpuInstrumentation: Baseline CPU profiler included post-sample getParameter calls; these are profiling overhead, not game work. Final runs stop CPU profiling before collection.
changes: Dungeon candidate bucket caches; exact authored cuboid checks remain, including geometry outside reserved footprint.
Fixture pose geometry/access caches; exact range-boundary changes, revision and model identity invalidate caches.
Root runtime solidity and physics synchronization changed concurrently; total timing changes cannot be attributed to any single patch.

intermediateDesktop.note: Earlier post-change desktop run loaded physics before its final optimization; final desktop run supersedes it. Baseline desktop FPS 4.5968.
